title: Neural Operators Which Certifiably Simultaneously Solve Infinitely Many Convex Programs using Logarithmic Rank and Linear Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2508.14995v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural operators (NOs) are a class of deep learning models designed to simultaneously solve infinitely many related problems by casting them into an infinite-dimensional space, whereon these NOs operate. Such operator learning problems arise naturally in mathematical finance, for instance, when learning families of optimal portfolios or hedging strategies. Two significant gaps, however, remain between theory and practice: 1) most universal approximation guarantees do not describe practically implementable NOs or are pure existence statements; and 2) worst-case parameter bounds from universal approximation theorems suggest that constructed NOs may require an unrealistically large number of parameters to solve most operator learning problems, which stands in direct opposition to a slew of experimental evidence. translated_title: 使用对数秩与线性复杂度、可认证地同时求解无穷多个凸规划问题的神经算子
translated_abstract: 神经算子（Neural Operators，NOs）是一类深度学习模型，旨在通过将相关问题投射到无穷维空间上并在其上进行操作，从而同时求解无穷多个相关问题。此类算子学习问题在数学金融中自然出现，例如在学习最优投资组合族或对冲策略族时。然而，理论与实践之间仍存在两个显著差距：1）大多数通用近似保证并未描述实际可实现的神经算子，或者只是纯粹的存在性陈述；2）通用近似定理给出的最坏情况参数界表明，所构造的神经算子可能需要不切实际的大量参数才能解决大多数算子学习问题，这与大量实验证据直接相悖。本文通过给出一个简短而简单的训练算法来构造一类特定的神经算子，弥合了这些差距……
tldr: 本文提出一种简短而简单的训练算法来构造特定类别的神经算子，可认证地同时求解无穷多个凸规划问题，且仅需对数秩与线性复杂度，从而弥合了神经算子理论与实践之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a short and simple training algorithm for constructing a specific class of neural operators that certifiably simultaneously solve infinitely many convex programs using logarithmic rank and linear complexity, closing the gap between theory and practice.
